Same-day releases download even when the catalog hasn't listed them yet,
and the dashboard gets its full redesign: pipeline-first layout,
attention banner, and a console aesthetic. No migration — pull the new
image and recreate the container.

## What changed

- **Provisional download works on real feed titles (fixes the missed Wano
  63).** A brand-new release lands before the catalog lists its CRC32, so
  the poll falls back to placing it from the title — but the parser left
  the trailing `.mkv` in place (`Wano 63 .mkv` has no numeric tail) and
  bailed out. The extension is now stripped before parsing, with a
  regression test on the actual Wano 63 title. No action needed on your
  end: the entry was never marked seen, so the next poll picks it up on
  its own.
- **Dashboard redesign.** Episodes lead the page; a top banner aggregates
  failed downloads, missing episodes, ready upgrades, and available
  updates with jump links (dismisses until the underlying problems
  change); sync buttons are named by effect (Fetch new releases, Audit
  library, Push fixes); library totals toggle gap filters over the arc
  list; static config moves to a grouped footer card. Finished in a
  console aesthetic: lit card edges, status LEDs, styled scrollbars, and
  visible focus that holds up in light and dark themes.
- **Phone layout fixed.** Closed dialogs leaked their width into the page
  and the banner grid pushed content off-viewport at 390px — a 17-check
  browser sweep caught both. Dialogs, banner, and the library header now
  wrap or hide correctly on small screens.
- **Download leftovers cleaned up, ours only.** Multi-file releases left
  their folders behind on import because the torrent entry was deleted
  without its files. Torrent deletion now takes the files with it, and
  each cycle sweeps download entries no live torrent references — scoped
  to top-level `[One Pace]`-named entries older than an hour, standing
  down entirely when qBittorrent is unreachable.
- **Base image on published `node:22.23.4-alpine`.** Docker Hub has
  published the fixed images, so both stages move off
  `node:22.23.3-alpine` and the temporary
  `NODE_OPTIONS=--use-openssl-ca` workaround is removed — TLS verifies
  against Node's corrected bundled roots again, with Alpine's fixed
  `ca-certificates` still installed fresh at build time as defense in
  depth. No application code changes.
- README screenshots re-captured against the live dashboard.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and recreate the container. If you were tracking the
Wano 63 miss, it downloads on the next poll with nothing to clean up.
